IT Rules 2021 Compliance

Unigram operates as an intermediary under the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021. We maintain a grievance redressal mechanism as mandated by these rules.

How to File a Complaint

Email us at grievance@unigram.app with the following details:

  • Subject format: "Grievance: [Issue Type]"
  • Examples: "Grievance: Defamatory Post", "Grievance: Privacy", "Grievance: Account Issue"
  • Your full name and roll number
  • Description of the issue
  • Link or screenshot (if applicable)

Response Timeline

Acknowledgment
Within 24 hours
Content Takedown
Within 36 hours
Account / Data Issues
Within 7 days

Types of Complaints

  • Content complaints (defamatory, harassing, illegal, explicit)
  • Privacy or data requests (access, correction, deletion)
  • Account issues (wrongful ban, impersonation, unauthorized access)
  • Technical issues

Data Deletion Requests

To delete your account and all associated data, email us with subject "Data Request: Delete Account". We process deletion requests within 30 days.

Appeal Process

If you are unsatisfied with the resolution of your complaint, you may submit an appeal by emailing us with subject: "Grievance Appeal: [Original ticket date]".

Important Note

Unigram is a student-run platform operated on a best-effort basis. We are not a 24/7 operation. We genuinely care about the community and will do our best to address every concern promptly. Thank you for your patience.
